label: Montana: applicability
note: Verified editorial summary, not a verbatim statutory extract. Primary text retrieved for the September 22, 2026 applicability candidate. Current 25,000/15,000 thresholds replaced 50,000/25,000 on October 1, 2025. Sections 2811,2818,2819 can apply below the general thresholds.
body: Does it conduct business in Montana OR produce products or services targeted to Montana residents?

Does it control or process personal data of at least 25,000 consumers (excluding payment-only data); OR at least 15,000 consumers AND derive strictly more than 25% of gross revenue from selling personal data?
Montana residents acting individually or as a household, excluding commercial and employment roles. Deduct payment-only data from the 25,000 limb.
Measuring period: §30-14-2803 does not state an annual or preceding-calendar-year period. Do not manufacture one; confirm counting methodology with the legal owner.
